options.text: Ask about a Seal of Passage.

steps.player: Do you have any quests?

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: As a matter of fact [Fremennik name], I do have a quest for you. Are you interested?

steps.player: I'm ready for another adventure!

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Excellent, now-

steps.player: So what will it be this time? Joining warring islands?

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: I'm a fan of your enthusiasm, [Fremennik name], but-

steps.player: Would you have me slay a mighty daggermouth? Or do you need my expertise in conquering untamed lands?

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Nothing quite that fancy I'm afraid, [Fremennik name]. I just need you to investigate a minor disturbance.

steps.player: Oh.

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Freygerd and Reeso run the sandpit a little north of here. They mentioned they heard some rustling by their hut last night and wanted an official to investigate.

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: You've proven yourself more than worthy of our people's trust.

steps.player: Well that doesn't sound so bad. I'll get right on it.

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Thank you, [Fremennik name].

steps.player: Not right now.

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Very well. Return when you wish to help.

options.text: Ask about a Seal of Passage.

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: How goes the investigation, [Fremennik name]?

steps.player: I'm still looking into it at the moment.

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: No rush, [Fremennik name]. I'm sure it's nothing to worry about. Just talk to Freygerd and Reeso at the sandpit when you're ready.

investigating-the-disturbance-reeso.speaker: Reeso
investigating-the-disturbance-reeso.text: Greetings, [Fremennik name]. I imagine the Chieftain sent you over. My wife, Freygerd, is probably the best person to speak to. She was the one who saw the... well whatever it was.

investigating-the-disturbance-reeso.speaker: Reeso
investigating-the-disturbance-reeso.text: I looked about outside but couldn't see anyone out there.

investigating-the-disturbance-reeso.player: I'll get to the bottom of it. Thank you Reeso.

investigating-the-disturbance-freygerd.player: The Chieftain told me that you saw some sort of disturbance outside your hut?

investigating-the-disturbance-freygerd.speaker: Freygerd
investigating-the-disturbance-freygerd.text: Yes, my husband thinks I'm going a bit mad but I know what I saw! Red eyes, piercing with a terrifying stare. I was so frightened, I fell to the floor!

investigating-the-disturbance-freygerd.speaker: Freygerd
investigating-the-disturbance-freygerd.text: It was the middle of the night, so I couldn't make out what it was. But when I got back on my feet, it wasn't there anymore.

investigating-the-disturbance-freygerd.player: I see. I'll have a look around and see what I can find.

investigating-the-disturbance-reeso-agai.speaker: Reeso
investigating-the-disturbance-reeso-agai.text: Try not to worry too much, I'm sure it's nothing.

investigating-the-disturbance-freygerd-a.speaker: Freygerd
investigating-the-disturbance-freygerd-a.text: Have you looked around the hut yet, [Fremennik name]?

investigating-the-disturbance-freygerd-a.player: I still think I'm missing something. I'll let you know when I'm done.

investigating-the-disturbance-freygerd-a.speaker: Freygerd
investigating-the-disturbance-freygerd-a.text: Thanks again for your help. Make sure you bring anything you find back. I'll make sure my husband delivers it to the Chieftain.

investigating-the-disturbance-searching-.text: If the player does not have inventory space:

steps.text: You spot an object by the boxes but you don't have enough room to take it.

investigating-the-disturbance-searching-.text: If the player has inventory space:

steps.text: You find what looks to be a venom gland.

steps.player: This doesn't look safe... Good job my backpack magically stops things from breaking!

investigating-the-disturbance-searching-.player: This seems to be a small sack filled with venom.

investigating-the-disturbance-searching-.text: If the player does not have inventory space:

steps.text: You spot an object by the rocks but you don't have enough room to take it.

investigating-the-disturbance-searching-.text: If the player has inventory space:

steps.text: You find some sort of fang.

steps.player: It's dripping with venom. I'd better make sure I don't prick my finger!

investigating-the-disturbance-searching-.player: This seems to be the fang of a relatively small creature. It's absolutely soaked in venom.

investigating-the-disturbance-searching-.text: Basilisk youngling jumps out of the sand pit

investigating-the-disturbance-searching-.player: Well I can honestly say I wasn't expecting that. Looks like it dropped a letter of some sorts. I'd better grab it.
I think I've found everything I need for this investigation. I should let Freygerd know.

investigating-the-disturbance-searching-.text: If the player has the Unsealed letter:

steps.player: I already have the letter from this sand pit.

investigating-the-disturbance-searching-.text: If the player lost the Unsealed letter and has no inventory space:

steps.text: You find an object in the sandpit but you don't have enough room to take it.

investigating-the-disturbance-searching-.text: If the player lost the Unsealed letter:

steps.text: You find the letter you lost.

steps.player: Oh, that's where that letter went! How convenient.

investigating-the-disturbance-after-acqu.player: I think I've found everything I need.

investigating-the-disturbance-after-acqu.speaker: Reeso
investigating-the-disturbance-after-acqu.text: Ah, you'd better talk to the wife then. She'll want to know what you've discovered.

investigating-the-disturbance-after-acqu.speaker: Freygerd
investigating-the-disturbance-after-acqu.text: Have you looked around the hut yet, [Fremennik name]?

investigating-the-disturbance-after-acqu.player: I've had a look around and found a few things I'd like to show the Chieftain. The thing that made the noise outside your home is gone now, so there's nothing to worry about.

investigating-the-disturbance-after-acqu.speaker: Freygerd
investigating-the-disturbance-after-acqu.text: Thank goodness! I'll have my husband take those items to the Chieftain for you.

investigating-the-disturbance-after-acqu.speaker: Freygerd
investigating-the-disturbance-after-acqu.text: Thank you so much for your help, [Fremennik name].

investigating-the-disturbance-after-acqu.player: No problem. I best be getting back to the Chieftain!

investigating-the-disturbance-after-acqu.speaker: Reeso
investigating-the-disturbance-after-acqu.text: Greetings, [Fremennik name]. How can I help?

investigating-the-disturbance-after-acqu.player: You didn't by any chance read that letter, did you?

investigating-the-disturbance-after-acqu.speaker: Reeso
investigating-the-disturbance-after-acqu.text: The sand business is booming over here in Rellekka! I don't have time to worry about some letter.

options.text: Thank you for letting me know.

steps.player: Thank you for letting me know.

steps.speaker: Reeso
steps.text: No problem, [Fremennik name].

options.text: Please, do tell me more about the sand business in Rellekka.

steps.player: Please, do tell me more about the sand business in Rellekka.

steps.speaker: Reeso
steps.text: An adventurer like you? Don't you have anything better to do?

steps.player: Not at all. I seem to have all day to talk to people. Why else would I start a conversation with you?

steps.speaker: Reeso
steps.text: Well, being so close to the shore, Rellekka provides a lot of seaweed alongside my sand.

steps.player: Tell me more!

steps.speaker: Reeso
steps.text: Well I work for a business known as Sandy Sand Co. A brilliant bunch of people!

steps.player: Interesting...

steps.speaker: Reeso
steps.text: The seaweed from Rellekka, in combination with my sand business, provides a huge amount of glass for the surrounding areas!

steps.speaker: Reeso
steps.text: Fellow Fremenniks aren't too pleased with my outside dealings, though know how important my job is. I think they let it slide for that reason.

steps.player: Well, thank you so much for all of that information Reeso. See you later.

investigating-the-disturbance-after-acqu.speaker: Freygerd
investigating-the-disturbance-after-acqu.text: You didn't say, [Fremennik name]. What exactly was it that was outside? My husband didn't tell me what he took to the Chieftain for you.

options.text: Terrify her with all the details.

steps.player: It was a basilisk.

steps.speaker: Freygerd
steps.text: What did you say?

steps.player: I said it was a basilisk.

steps.speaker: Freygerd
steps.text: A basilisk?

steps.player: Well I really must get back to what I was doing. Lovely to catch up!
It was nothing to worry about! Just a couple of knick knacks probably dropped by some kids!

steps.speaker: Freygerd
steps.text: What about the red eyes I saw though?

steps.player: They were probably just firestarters. That's what I found outside.

steps.speaker: Freygerd
steps.text: Well that's certainly a relief. Thank you for letting me know!

steps.player: Not a problem!

investigating-the-disturbance-after-acqu.speaker: Freygerd
investigating-the-disturbance-after-acqu.text: A basilisk! In our town! This is how it starts!

investigating-the-disturbance-after-acqu.player: Well that sounds cheery. You have nothing to fear though, not with me around. Speaking of which, I'd better get back to it.

options.text: Ask about a Seal of Passage.

options.condition: If the player has not read the letter

steps.text: If the player has not read the letter:

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: [Fremennik name], I'm glad you've returned! This letter you have found is very worrying and requires our utmost attention.
If the player does not already have the letter:
The Chieftain hands you the letter back.

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Never did we think this day would come.

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: So many lives lost. So many sacrifices.

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: But the Fremennik people shall not bow to the Jormungand again!

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: [Fremennik name], please read the letter and talk to me afterwards with any questions you may have.
If the player has read the letter:

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: [Fremennik name], I'm glad you've returned! This letter you have found is very worrying and requires our utmost attention.

steps.player: I don't understand. What does the letter mean? Who is the Jormungand? And since when could basilisks read and write?

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: While they may not show it, basilisks are much smarter than they seem. Many years ago, a great basilisk army enslaved our people and took our home.

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: The Jormungand, sometimes known as The Serpent King, was the leader of this army. Along with his three generals, Typhor, Vritra and Bakuna, he brought a terror to these lands unlike any other.

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: If it hadn't been for the bravery of a great hero, we might never have been freed.

steps.player: A hero?

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Yes. He was known as V. He stood up to the Serpent King and confronted him on the Island of Stone. It is said that the two of them fought for days, but in the end, V stood victorious.

steps.player: What happened next?

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Well that depends who you ask. The bards wrote a great song about V's victory. They called it the Ballad of the Basilisk, and it claims V killed the Jormungand.

steps.player: But...

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Well... bards are known to bend the truth a bit, especially if it makes a song sound better. In reality, V sealed the Serpent King in a magical prison on the island, where he remains to this day.

steps.player: A magical prison? I thought the Fremennik people didn't approve of magic?

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: V was different. Stories tell of how he unlocked the potential of magic with the single touch of a stone. In that moment, he became more than just a man.

steps.player: A god?

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: It's not a distinction the Fremennik particularly care for. To us, he has always been a hero to be respected, not a god to be worshipped. They say he felt the same way.

steps.player: But he earned the right to use magic?

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Exactly. Now the Moon Clan on the other hand, did not earn that right. Their use of magic is an insult to our people.

steps.player: So what can we do about the Jormungand?

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: We will stay strong, [Fremennik name]. We'll...

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: We'll be doomed!

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Our army isn't large enough to hold back the forces of the Serpent King.

steps.player: I can help!

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: [Fremennik name], you're strong. But you're no army.

steps.player: You're forgetting Brundt. We have the element of surprise! They don't know we're aware of their attack.
We could have days to prepare before they make their move. We could...

steps.text: Cutscene starts with Agnar running in.

steps.speaker: Agnar
steps.text: Chieftain Brundt!

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Agnar? What is it?

steps.speaker: Agnar
steps.text: Chieftain Brundt! I'm here on behalf of the Fremennik Council! We've heard some disturbing news about a basilisk in town.

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Well I won't deny there's been a little issue but [Fremennik name] and I will soon have things back under control.

steps.speaker: Agnar
steps.text: [Fremennik name]? When will you see that this outerlander is the cause of all of our problems!

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: [Fremennik name] is no outerlander! [He/She] passed our trials and is a Fremennik, just like you and I.

steps.speaker: Agnar
steps.text: You can disguise it all you want, but [he/she] is an outerlander and always will be! Ever since we let [him/her] in, we've had nothing but trouble!

steps.speaker: Agnar
steps.text: And to top it all off, now we have basilisks wandering our town. The council have had enough!

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: What are you saying Agnar?

steps.speaker: Agnar
steps.text: I have a declaration here signed by seven of our twelve council members. We declare this outerlander an exile!

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: This is outrageous! [Fremennik name] is one of us!

steps.speaker: Agnar
steps.text: Do not use that name! The decision of the council is final. As Chieftain, you are honour bound to enact it.

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: I see...

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Exile, you must leave our province. Our people will no longer see you as their brother.
Chieftain Brundt gestures his head towards the south east.

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Leave at once. Do not attempt to interact with myself or my people.

being-exiled-brundt.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
being-exiled-brundt.text: Begone exile, you are a Fremennik no more.

being-exiled-brundt.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
being-exiled-brundt.text: Leave at once. Do not attempt to interact with myself or my people.

being-exiled-askeladden.speaker: Askeladden
being-exiled-askeladden.text: Hey pal... listen. I shouldn't really be talking to you. Everyone is saying you're a bad person. They say you were exiled!

being-exiled-askeladden.player: It's true but I did nothing wrong; don't believe them Askeladden!

being-exiled-askeladden.speaker: Askeladden
being-exiled-askeladden.text: I believe you buddy! I just can't really be seen talking to you.

being-exiled-askeladden.player: That's fine, I don't want to get you in trouble. Can you do me a favour though?

options.text: Can I have another pet rock?

steps.text: (Non-quest dialogue.)

steps.player: Actually, never mind.

steps.speaker: Askeladden
steps.text: Okay pal. If you need anything, come back to me but keep it on the down low.

being-exiled-bardur.speaker: Bardur
being-exiled-bardur.text: Ah! Exile! Begone with you, before you suffer the same fate as these fledglings!

steps.speaker: Bjorn/Eldgrim
steps.text: Gerr owtta 'ere befur ay mayke yew!

steps.speaker: Bjorn/Eldgrim
steps.text: Behgawn exshiled. Elsh'll cahll thur gards!

steps.speaker: Bjorn/Eldgrim
steps.text: Yoo shuwdn't be warking 'round alown whyle exshiled!

being-exiled-falo-the-bard.speaker: Falo the Bard
being-exiled-falo-the-bard.text: Hi there exile. I am Falo the bard! Like my brother Olaf, who lives in Rellekka, I also write music.

being-exiled-falo-the-bard.player: You don't seem to care too much about me getting exiled.

being-exiled-falo-the-bard.speaker: Falo the Bard
being-exiled-falo-the-bard.text: Well we're not in Rellekka down here so I don't think it matters too much.

being-exiled-falo-the-bard.player: Fair enough. So, do you write about anything in particular?

being-exiled-jarvald-rellekka.speaker: Jarvald
being-exiled-jarvald-rellekka.text: Forgive me exile, though I can't allow you to board my ship.

steps.player: Please Jarvald, it's really important!

steps.speaker: Jarvald
steps.text: Very well... for old times sake.

steps.player: Fair enough.

being-exiled-jarvald-waterbirth-island.speaker: Jarvald
being-exiled-jarvald-waterbirth-island.text: Do you wish to return to Rellekka?

steps.player: Yes please.

steps.speaker: Jarvald
steps.text: Very well, but do make sure you're not spotted leaving my ship.

steps.player: No thanks.

being-exiled-maria-gunnars.speaker: Maria Gunnars
being-exiled-maria-gunnars.text: Welcome back, [Fremennik name]. Do you have any questions?

being-exiled-maria-gunnars.player: You don't seem to be bothered about my exile.

being-exiled-maria-gunnars.speaker: Maria Gunnars
being-exiled-maria-gunnars.text: I'm not. Neitiznot does not consider you an exile, that's just the mainland.

being-exiled-mord-gunnars.player: Heh. Thanks - I was pretty heroic even if I say so myself.
You do know I've been exiled right? You don't seem to care.

being-exiled-mord-gunnars.speaker: Mord Gunnars
being-exiled-mord-gunnars.text: Don't worry [Fremennik name], your exile does not cover the island of Jatizso. We still consider you a Fremennik.

being-exiled-pet-rock.text: Your pet rock ignores you. You are an exile of the Fremennik Province.
Your pet rock continues to ignore you.

options.text: Please, I must get to Miscellania.

steps.player: Please, I must get to Miscellania.

steps.speaker: Sailor
steps.text: You're lucky you're needed there. Just don't speak to me on the journey!

steps.player: Let's go!

steps.text: The player travels to Miscellania.

steps.player: Sorry.

being-exiled-sailor-rellekka-right-click.speaker: Sailor
being-exiled-sailor-rellekka-right-click.text: You're lucky you're needed on Miscellania exile. Just don't speak to me on the journey!

being-exiled-sailor-miscellania.player: Hello. Can I get a ride on your ship?

being-exiled-sailor-miscellania.speaker: Sailor
being-exiled-sailor-miscellania.text: Fine. I won't pretend to like it though.

steps.player: Let's go!

steps.text: The player travels to Rellekka.

steps.speaker: Sailor
steps.text: Okay. Suit yourself.

being-exiled-sailor-miscellania-right-cl.speaker: Sailor
being-exiled-sailor-miscellania-right-cl.text: Let's go exile. Sooner you're off my ship the better.

being-exiled-thorodin.speaker: Thorodin
being-exiled-thorodin.text: Exile. You don't have many friends around here at the moment.

being-exiled-thorodin.player: How do you feel about it?

being-exiled-thorodin.speaker: Thorodin
being-exiled-thorodin.text: Doesn't bother me. Some people take these things more seriously than others. On that note, do you need something?

being-exiled-torfinn-before-dragon-slaye.speaker: Torfinn
being-exiled-torfinn-before-dragon-slaye.text: Sorry [Fremennik name], I can't be seen talking to you.

being-exiled-torfinn-after-dragon-slayer.speaker: Torfinn
being-exiled-torfinn-after-dragon-slayer.text: I'm not meant to be talking to you [Fremennik name]. I guess I can still take you to Ungael though if you want.

being-exiled-torfinn-after-dragon-slayer.speaker: Torfinn
being-exiled-torfinn-after-dragon-slayer.text: Do you want to return to Rellekka?

steps.speaker: NPC
steps.text: Leave exile, before I alert the guards.

steps.speaker: NPC
steps.text: Leave now, before I get rid of you myself.

steps.speaker: NPC
steps.text: Begone exile, you're no [brother/sister/Fremennik] to me.

steps.speaker: NPC
steps.text: Begone exile, before I call the Fremennik guards!

steps.speaker: NPC
steps.text: I'm sorry, you are Fremennik no more. I cannot help you. Leave, before I must call the guards.

undoing-the-exilement-brundt.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
undoing-the-exilement-brundt.text: Indeed. I'm sorry [Fremennik name]. The reality is that many on the council did not take kindly to you becoming one of us. They've been looking for a good excuse to exile you ever since you arrived.

undoing-the-exilement-brundt.player: But they're the ones that voted for me in the first place!

undoing-the-exilement-brundt.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
undoing-the-exilement-brundt.text: Well... not quite. Seven of the twelve council members gave you their vote, but you never had the support of the other five. They're the ones who've been pushing for your exile.

undoing-the-exilement-brundt.player: I see. And they've used this basilisk problem to convince some of the others.

undoing-the-exilement-brundt.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
undoing-the-exilement-brundt.text: It would seem so. Try not to judge them too harshly though, they only had what was best for the province in mind. This basilisk situation has a lot of people scared.

undoing-the-exilement-brundt.player: I don't understand though, they're only basilisks. Surely we have the strength to defeat them.

undoing-the-exilement-brundt.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
undoing-the-exilement-brundt.text: Ah, I see you are not familiar with the End of Things.

undoing-the-exilement-brundt.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
undoing-the-exilement-brundt.text: Many years ago, before the time of V, it was foretold that this world will end in a great battle. They called this battle Ragnarok, or more commonly, the End of Things.

undoing-the-exilement-brundt.player: Well that doesn't sound good. Where do the basilisks fit in?

undoing-the-exilement-brundt.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
undoing-the-exilement-brundt.text: The prophecies say that the battle will begin after the Serpent King is freed. So you see, it is not the basilisks people fear, it is what comes after.

undoing-the-exilement-brundt.player: Then we'd better make sure the Jormungand stays in that prison!

undoing-the-exilement-brundt.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
undoing-the-exilement-brundt.text: Well, [Fremennik name], that's why I asked you to meet me out here. If you are to help us put a stop to this threat, you'll need to regain the trust of the council. And I think I know just how you can do that.

undoing-the-exilement-brundt.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
undoing-the-exilement-brundt.text: I think the best possible way to show your worth to them is by being the person that restores V's Shield.

undoing-the-exilement-brundt.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
undoing-the-exilement-brundt.text: The shield used by V when he defeated the Serpent King. It is legendary amongst our people. If we are to have any chance of stopping this threat, we will need to remake it.

undoing-the-exilement-brundt.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
undoing-the-exilement-brundt.text: There's a few things I know about the shield, though other things are lost from stories past.

undoing-the-exilement-brundt.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
undoing-the-exilement-brundt.text: I believe some members of the Moon Clan might know the details I don't, so your diplomatic relations should come in handy.

undoing-the-exilement-brundt.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
undoing-the-exilement-brundt.text: Keep in mind, now that you've been exiled, most people in the province will be unlikely to talk to you.

undoing-the-exilement-brundt.player: Fair enough. So where should I start?

undoing-the-exilement-brundt.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
undoing-the-exilement-brundt.text: Stories tell of how V's Shield was made using four components.

undoing-the-exilement-brundt.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
undoing-the-exilement-brundt.text: First, the base of the shield. This was a traditional Fremennik Shield, like the ones our warriors use.

undoing-the-exilement-brundt.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
undoing-the-exilement-brundt.text: Next, the Lunar Glass. This was apparently created by a great Moon Clan mystic and was used to reflect the Serpent King's gaze.

undoing-the-exilement-brundt.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
undoing-the-exilement-brundt.text: Then you have the Polishing Rock. This was needed to shine the Lunar Glass. This rock was heated softly in a boiling spring.

undoing-the-exilement-brundt.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
undoing-the-exilement-brundt.text: Finally, V's Sigil. This sigil was crafted by the Moon Clan, using a unique metal known only to them.

options.text: Where can I find a Fremennik Shield?

steps.player: Where can I find a Fremennik Shield?

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Fremennik Shields are only given to warriors of the province.

steps.player: I made a round shield with arctic pine in my previous adventure to Neitiznot?

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: No, this shield is different. I'd recommend heading to Waterbirth Island. The daggermouths within the dungeon will likely have some from warriors they've sent to Valhalla.

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: You could slay them and reclaim a shield from their corpses.

steps.player: What if that doesn't work?

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: There's a warrior down there known as Bardur, gathering many a daggermouth hide and saving Fremennik Shields.

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: If you have no luck finding a shield, perhaps you could charm him to give one to you?

steps.player: Thanks Brundt, I'll keep that in mind.

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: No problem.

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Do you have any more questions about V's Shield, [Fremennik name]?

options.text: Where can I get Lunar Glass?
How do I make the Polishing Rock?
How do I make V's Sigil?

steps.player: That's all thanks.
Goodbye.

options.text: Where can I get Lunar Glass?

steps.player: Where can I get Lunar Glass?

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: I'm not sure I'm afraid. I imagine someone from the Moon Clan would likely have more knowledge on the matter.

steps.player: I think I know just the chicken-legged-house-bound lady to ask!

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: What?

steps.player: Don't worry about it...

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Do you have any more questions about V's Shield, [Fremennik name]?

options.text: Where can I find a Fremennik Shield?
How do I make the Polishing Rock?
How do I make V's Sigil?
How do I make the Polishing Rock?

steps.player: How do I make the Polishing Rock?

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Well firstly, a rock would probably help...

steps.player: I know a guy! Well, a boy. Hopefully he'll still be willing to speak to me despite the exile.

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Convenient. As for the matter of heating the rock, there's some hot springs on the mountain to the east that should be warm enough.

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Use something to lower the rock into one of the geysers there, and you should be good to go.

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Do you have any more questions about V's Shield, [Fremennik name]?

options.text: Where can I find a Fremennik Shield?
How do I make the Polishing Rock?
How do I make V's Sigil?
How do I make V's Sigil?

steps.player: How do I make V's Sigil?

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: V's Sigil is, well... in the shape of a V.

steps.player: Oh... is that it?

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Well, one side of the sigil is shaped like a basilisk. Spines down its back, and maw wide like a gate.

steps.player: And the other side?

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Nothing fancy. Just the other side of the letter V.

steps.player: What exactly is it made of?

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: The stories tell of a cave on Lunar Isle where V first gained his power. Apparently it contains a unique metal used only by the Moon Clan.

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: I'd say three bars of this metal should be enough. Take them to an anvil and you should be able to make the sigil.

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Once you have made the sigil, you'll need to have it enchanted. This was apparently done by a powerful spirit.

steps.player: Do you know of such a spirit?

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: The stories didn't specify, though I would wager the Fossegrimen might be able to help.

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Do you have any more questions about V's Shield, [Fremennik name]?

options.text: Where can I find a Fremennik Shield?
How do I make the Polishing Rock?
How do I make V's Sigil?

steps.player: Goodbye.

making-v-s-shield-fremennik-shield-bardu.speaker: Bardur
making-v-s-shield-fremennik-shield-bardu.text: Ah! Exile! Begone with you, before you suffer the same fate as these fledglings!

making-v-s-shield-fremennik-shield-bardu.player: Bardur, wait! I'm here with a task from the Chieftain.

making-v-s-shield-fremennik-shield-bardu.speaker: Bardur
making-v-s-shield-fremennik-shield-bardu.text: I'm not too certain I should trust you! What is it you want?

making-v-s-shield-fremennik-shield-bardu.player: I'm looking to remake V's Shield, but I require a Fremennik Shield from a warrior. Where could I find one?

making-v-s-shield-fremennik-shield-bardu.text: If the player has a Fremennik shield in their inventory:

steps.speaker: Bardur
steps.text: You already have one! Begone, exile!

making-v-s-shield-fremennik-shield-bardu.text: If the player does not have a Fremennik shield in their inventory:

steps.speaker: Bardur
steps.text: The daggermouths found in these caves should drop a few when slain. They take them from fallen warriors. I have a few myself, in fact. I wish to give them back to the families of the fallen.

steps.speaker: Bardur
steps.text: These fledgelings won't drop anything you're looking for, though. Search the caves for some matured daggermouths.

steps.player: Thanks for your time, Bardur.

steps.speaker: Bardur
steps.text: You're lucky I'm busy exile! Things might have been different if I wasn't...

options.text: Maybe I could buy one off you?

steps.player: Maybe I could buy one off you?

steps.speaker: Bardur
steps.text: Hmm... Well I suppose the money would be of great help to the families of the fallen. Very well, I will sell you a shield for 150,000 coins.

steps.player: Sounds good to me.

steps.text: a Fremennik shield for 150,000 coins

steps.speaker: Bardur
steps.text: Perhaps I misjudged you, exile. Best of luck on your adventure.

options.text: That's far too much, I won't pay that!

steps.player: That's far too much, I won't pay that!

steps.speaker: Bardur
steps.text: Well I wouldn't expect an exile like you to care about the fallen. Be gone with you!

options.text: (Charm) I could honour the fallen by remaking V's Shield.
options.condition: If the player is wearing a Ring of Charos(a):

steps.player: I could honour the fallen by remaking V's Shield.

steps.speaker: Bardur
steps.text: Hmm... They would indeed be pleased. Having your shield used to make the shield of a hero would be an honour!

steps.player: So what do you say?

steps.speaker: Bardur
steps.text: Very well...
a Fremennik shield

steps.player: Thanks Bardur.

steps.speaker: Bardur
steps.text: Perhaps I misjudged you, exile. Best of luck on your adventure.

making-v-s-shield-fremennik-shield-bardu.speaker: Bardur
making-v-s-shield-fremennik-shield-bardu.text: Exile, has that shield served you well?
If the player has a Fremennik shield in their inventory, bank, or any item retrieval service:

steps.player: Yes, thank you.

steps.speaker: Bardur
steps.text: All the best, exile.

making-v-s-shield-fremennik-shield-bardu.text: If the player does not have a Fremennik shield in their inventory, bank, or any item retrieval service:

steps.player: I lost it.

steps.speaker: Bardur
steps.text: Well you're not having another one if that's how you take care of things! If you want another, you'll need to slay some daggermouths!

steps.player: Okay...

making-v-s-shield-lunar-glass-baba-yaga.speaker: Baba Yaga
making-v-s-shield-lunar-glass-baba-yaga.text: Ah! [player name], I'm glad to see you've returned. How can I help?

options.text: Have you got anything to trade?
It's a very interesting house you have here.
I was wondering if you could help me make Lunar Glass?

steps.player: I was wondering if you could help me make...

steps.speaker: Baba Yaga
steps.text: Lunar Glass?

steps.player: You really need to stop doing that.

steps.speaker: Baba Yaga
steps.text: Stop doing what?

steps.player: Stop finishing my...

steps.speaker: Baba Yaga
steps.text: Sentences? Sorry it's a force of habit! Mind reading and watnot.

steps.speaker: Baba Yaga
steps.text: Oh don't look at me like that! I'm not the one who exiled you.

steps.player: Look, those are my private thoughts! You can't just go reading my mind without permission.

steps.speaker: Baba Yaga
steps.text: Those aren't private thoughts! They're nothing compared to the other things I can see...

steps.player: Please... can we just focus on the matter at hand?

steps.text: If the player does not have molten glass in their inventory:

steps.speaker: Baba Yaga
steps.text: Sure thing! Lunar Glass isn't so hard to make, but I will require a piece of Molten Glass. Return to me when you have some!

steps.player: Thank y...

steps.speaker: Baba Yaga
steps.text: You're welcome.
If the player has molten glass in their inventory:

steps.speaker: Baba Yaga
steps.text: Sure thing! Lunar Glass isn't so hard to make, but I will require...

steps.player: Some Molten Glass? I have some right here!

steps.speaker: Baba Yaga
steps.text: Hey! That's... really annoying.

steps.player: Oh, how the tables have turned!

steps.speaker: Baba Yaga
steps.text: How did you even know...

steps.speaker: Baba Yaga
steps.text: Anyway, let me imbue this piece of glass for you.
Baba Yaga imbues a piece of Molten Glass for you.

steps.speaker: Baba Yaga
steps.text: You will need to enchant it by using it on the Astral Altar. The process will also require 100 Astral Runes.

steps.player: Oh. Can't you just do it for me?

steps.speaker: Baba Yaga
steps.text: Afraid not, I have lots of tidying to do around here.

steps.player: Tidying?

steps.speaker: Baba Yaga
steps.text: Have you ever tried living in a house that's constantly shaking? It's a total nightmare, believe me.

steps.player: I guess I never thought about that before, fair enough.

steps.speaker: Baba Yaga
steps.text: Best of luck, [player name].

steps.text: You need at least 100 Astral runes to attempt to enchant the glass.

steps.text: You successfully enchant the glass and create some Lunar Glass.

steps.speaker: Baba Yaga

steps.speaker: Baba Yaga
steps.text: Lunar Glass? But I can see you already have some! You don't have to be a mind reader to see that...

making-v-s-shield-lunar-glass-enchanting.player: I already have some Lunar Glass. I should probably gather the rest of the items for V's Shield!

making-v-s-shield-polishing-rock-small-g.text: If the player does not have a pet rock in their inventory:
If the player has a pet rock in their inventory:

steps.player: This geyser looks a little small. I'd probably do a better job heating this rock in a larger geyser!

making-v-s-shield-polishing-rock-large-g.text: If the player does not have a pet rock in their inventory:
If the player has a pet rock in their inventory:

steps.player: Okay, here we go!

steps.text: Your pet rock stares deeply into your eyes.

steps.player: Any second now, I'm going to lower this rock into the geyser and boil it...

steps.text: Your pet rock looks sad...

steps.player: It's just a rock, how is it looking so sad? Come on, I can do this! For the Province!

steps.prompt: Are you cruel enough to sacrifice your pet rock?

options.text: It's for the good of the Province!

steps.player: It's for the good of the Province... I must do it!

steps.text: Your pet rock gives you a stern look.

options.text: I can't do it! I love you pet rock.

steps.player: I can't do it! I love you pet rock.

steps.text: Your pet rock gives you a stern look.

steps.player: You're right, pet rock... Why does it have to be this way?

steps.text: You stroke your pet rock one last time, and reminisce about your previous adventures.

steps.player: I can't do this to you with all of these happy memories!

steps.text: Your pet rock gives you an empowering look.

steps.player: You're right... I'll talk to Peer the Seer. He'll help me forget all of our times together.
It'll make this easier.

making-v-s-shield-polishing-rock-large-g.player: I can't do this to you with all of these happy memories!

making-v-s-shield-polishing-rock-large-g.text: Your pet rock gives you an empowering look.

making-v-s-shield-polishing-rock-large-g.player: You're right... I'll talk to Peer the Seer. He'll help me forget all of our times together.

making-v-s-shield-polishing-rock-peer-th.speaker: Peer the Seer
making-v-s-shield-polishing-rock-peer-th.text: Though I appreciate your efforts in our trials, I'm afraid I can't speak to you [Fremennik name].

making-v-s-shield-polishing-rock-peer-th.player: Please, Seer! I'm on a mission for Brundt.

making-v-s-shield-polishing-rock-peer-th.speaker: Peer the Seer
making-v-s-shield-polishing-rock-peer-th.text: Hmm... If the Chieftain can still trust you, so can I. How may I be of assistance?

making-v-s-shield-polishing-rock-peer-th.player: It's a bit of a sensitive subject...

making-v-s-shield-polishing-rock-peer-th.speaker: Peer the Seer
making-v-s-shield-polishing-rock-peer-th.text: You can tell me anything, [Fremennik name]. What's the matter?

making-v-s-shield-polishing-rock-peer-th.player: I can't bring myself to boil my pet rock!
I know, I'm a horrible person! Please help me, I can't bring myself to do it.

making-v-s-shield-polishing-rock-peer-th.speaker: Peer the Seer
making-v-s-shield-polishing-rock-peer-th.text: Are you serious? I'm a busy man...

making-v-s-shield-polishing-rock-peer-th.player: Please Seer, you're my only hope!

making-v-s-shield-polishing-rock-peer-th.speaker: Peer the Seer
making-v-s-shield-polishing-rock-peer-th.text: Very well. I'll clear your mind of any memories you have of your...

making-v-s-shield-polishing-rock-peer-th.speaker: Peer the Seer
making-v-s-shield-polishing-rock-peer-th.text: I won't be able to speak with you after this. The others might start to get suspicious.

making-v-s-shield-polishing-rock-peer-th.player: Thank you, Seer! I'll head back to the mountains now.

making-v-s-shield-polishing-rock-peer-th.speaker: Peer the Seer
making-v-s-shield-polishing-rock-peer-th.text: Now be gone with you, exile!

making-v-s-shield-polishing-rock-peer-th.player: I know it's just an act... but that hurt.

making-v-s-shield-polishing-rock-large-g.text: You place the rock in the geyser.

making-v-s-shield-polishing-rock-large-g.player: Well I don't think that will be bobbing up to the top anytime soon! I'll need to fish it out with something.
I'm not going to be able to get my rock back with just my bare hands! I'll need to get something to fish it out.
I've already dropped one rock in there. I should try fishing it out rather than throwing more away.

making-v-s-shield-polishing-rock-large-g.text: If there is no pet rock inside the geyser:

steps.text: You wrap the rock around the fishing line and lower it into the geyser.

making-v-s-shield-polishing-rock-large-g.text: If there is a pet rock inside the geyser:

steps.text: You cast your fishing line into the geyser.

making-v-s-shield-polishing-rock-large-g.text: You reel the rock back up from the geyser...
If the player does not have the Ice gloves or Smiths gloves (i) equipped:

steps.player: Ow!

steps.text: You drop your rock into the geyser.
If the player does not have either the Ice gloves or Smiths gloves (i) in their inventory:

steps.player: Darn it! That rock was hot...
If only I had something that could keep my hands cold!

steps.text: If the player has the Ice gloves or Smiths gloves (i) in their inventory:

steps.player: Darn it! It would probably help if I actually wore my ice gloves.

making-v-s-shield-polishing-rock-large-g.text: If the player has the Ice gloves or Smiths gloves (i) equipped:

steps.text: The geyser has heated your rock, giving you a Polishing Rock.
a Polishing rock

making-v-s-shield-polishing-rock-inspect.text: If the polishing rock is in the player's inventory:

steps.player: I already have a Polishing Rock. I think I'm done here.

making-v-s-shield-polishing-rock-inspect.text: If the polishing rock is in the player's bank:

steps.player: I already have a Polishing Rock in my bank. I think I'm done here.

making-v-s-shield-v-sigil-anvil.text: If the player has fewer than 3 lunar bars in their inventory:

steps.text: You require 3 Lunar bars to make a V sigil.

making-v-s-shield-v-sigil-anvil.text: If the player has at least 3 lunar bars in their inventory:

steps.prompt: Would you like to make a V Sigil?

steps.text: You hammer the three Lunar bars and make a V Sigil, exactly how Brundt described.
It will still need to be enchanted before it can be used for V's Shield.

making-v-s-shield-v-sigil-fossegrimen.speaker: Fossegrimen
making-v-s-shield-v-sigil-fossegrimen.text: What can I do for you?

making-v-s-shield-v-sigil-fossegrimen.player: I hear that I can present you with an offering and you will enchant my lyre for me.

making-v-s-shield-v-sigil-fossegrimen.speaker: Fossegrimen
making-v-s-shield-v-sigil-fossegrimen.text: This is true. For a simple enchantment, you may place an offering on my Altar. Can I help you with anything else?

options.text: Present offering of a single fish.
Ask about a permanent lyre enchantment.

steps.player: I'm currently trying to remake V's Shield. I was told I need his sigil enchanted by a powerful spirit.

steps.speaker: Fossegrimen
steps.text: V? Now that's a name I haven't heard in a long time...

steps.player: You know of V?

steps.speaker: Fossegrimen
steps.text: Oh yes. Were it not for V, this conversation might never had happened.

steps.speaker: Fossegrimen
steps.text: I owe V a debt that can never be repaid. It would be an honour to enchant his sigil.
If the player does not have the V sigil in their inventory:

steps.speaker: Fossegrimen
steps.text: Bring the unenchanted sigil to me and I'll provide you with what you need.
If the player has the V sigil in their inventory:

steps.speaker: Fossegrimen
steps.text: The Fossegrimen whispers an enchantment*

steps.speaker: Fossegrimen
steps.text: There you go! Go forth mighty warrior.

making-v-s-shield-making-the-shield-brun.player: I think I have everything needed to make V's Shield.

making-v-s-shield-making-the-shield-brun.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
making-v-s-shield-making-the-shield-brun.text: Well what are you waiting for? Get it made and we'll have everything we need to put an end to your exile.

making-v-s-shield-making-the-shield-usin.text: If the player does not have a glassblowing pipe:

steps.text: You need a Glassblowing Pipe to make V's Shield.

making-v-s-shield-making-the-shield-usin.text: If the player has a glassblowing pipe:

steps.text: You meld the Lunar Glass to the Fremennik Shield. You then polish it with the Polishing Rock, which cools as you do so. Finally, you attach the V Sigil, finishing the shield.
V's shield

making-v-s-shield-making-the-shield-insp.player: This looks complete! I should head back to the Chieftain and see what he thinks.

making-v-s-shield-making-the-shield-brun.player: Oh, sorry. I simply left it in my bank. I'm such a ditzy person sometimes!

making-v-s-shield-making-the-shield-brun.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
making-v-s-shield-making-the-shield-brun.text: That's certainly one way to put it... Perhaps you should go and get it?
You hand V's Shield to Brundt the Chieftain.

making-v-s-shield-making-the-shield-brun.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
making-v-s-shield-making-the-shield-brun.text: [Fremennik name]... This is incredible! It's as if you forged the shield from a picture. It's exactly how I imagined it from the stories!

making-v-s-shield-making-the-shield-brun.player: Do you think this will be enough to convince the council?

making-v-s-shield-making-the-shield-brun.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
making-v-s-shield-making-the-shield-brun.text: I hope so [Fremennik name]. I do suspect some of them may never respect you though.

making-v-s-shield-making-the-shield-brun.player: Beggars can't be choosers, I suppose. Let's get going then...

making-v-s-shield-making-the-shield-brun.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
making-v-s-shield-making-the-shield-brun.text: The shield. It requires one last thing.

making-v-s-shield-making-the-shield-brun.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
making-v-s-shield-making-the-shield-brun.text: Return to me with two beers. No... Two kegs of beer! Quickly! There's not much time!

making-v-s-shield-making-the-shield-brun.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
making-v-s-shield-making-the-shield-brun.text: Have you got the two kegs of beer?

making-v-s-shield-making-the-shield-brun.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
making-v-s-shield-making-the-shield-brun.text: I'm litchrally abousht to go shtand uhp to the enshtire *hiccup* counshil for yooo...! I need thish!

making-v-s-shield-making-the-shield-brun.player: That's a very good point. Carry on then.
I should probably head back to the longhall...

making-v-s-shield-making-the-shield-brun.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
making-v-s-shield-making-the-shield-brun.text: Return to me with two beers. No... Two kegs of beer! Quickly! There's not much time!

making-v-s-shield-making-the-shield-brun.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
making-v-s-shield-making-the-shield-brun.text: You're a bigger alcoholic than I am! Hand them over.
The chieftain takes both kegs and quickly drinks one.

basilisks-in-the-market-brundt.player: And you Brundt. You sobered up quickly.

basilisks-in-the-market-brundt.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
basilisks-in-the-market-brundt.text: We Fremennik know how to handle a drink, [Fremennik name]. Anyway, I have some good news for you.

basilisks-in-the-market-brundt.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
basilisks-in-the-market-brundt.text: Following your successful recreation of V's Shield, the council have agreed to end your exile. I hearby declare you a Fremennik again!

basilisks-in-the-market-brundt.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
basilisks-in-the-market-brundt.text: Not only that, but we would like you to be the one to carry V's legendary shield into battle.

basilisks-in-the-market-brundt.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
basilisks-in-the-market-brundt.text: So you should be [Fremennik name]. V was our greatest hero. There is no greater honour than to bear his shield in battle.
Brundt the Chieftain gives you V's Shield.

basilisks-in-the-market-brundt.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
basilisks-in-the-market-brundt.text: The basilisks intend to attack the town so they can keep us distracted while they free the Jormungand. Luckily for us, we know about this.

basilisks-in-the-market-brundt.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
basilisks-in-the-market-brundt.text: Once the attack begins, the majority of our forces will stay here to hold the town. While they do, you and I will journey to the Island of Stone.

basilisks-in-the-market-brundt.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
basilisks-in-the-market-brundt.text: There, we will ensure that the prison of the Jormungand remains sealed.

basilisks-in-the-market-brundt.speaker: Fremennik Warrior
basilisks-in-the-market-brundt.text: Basilisks in the market! Basilisks in the market!

basilisks-in-the-market-brundt.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
basilisks-in-the-market-brundt.text: They've walked right through our defences!

basilisks-in-the-market-brundt.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
basilisks-in-the-market-brundt.text: They've walked right through our defences!

basilisks-in-the-market-during-the-fight.text: Fremennik Warriors, Koschei the Deathless, Thorvald the Warrior and Brundt the Chieftain will say one of the phrases while in combat throughout the Market Fight.

steps.speaker: NPC
steps.text: This is Rellekka!

steps.speaker: NPC
steps.text: Kill the invaders!

steps.speaker: NPC
steps.text: You die here beast!

steps.speaker: NPC
steps.text: Die you foul beasts!

steps.speaker: NPC
steps.text: Death to the basilisks!

steps.speaker: NPC
steps.text: Kill them! Kill them all!

steps.speaker: NPC
steps.text: You will not take our home!

options.text: Ask about a Seal of Passage.

steps.speaker: Fremennik Warrior
steps.text: Basilisks in the market! Basilisks in the market!

basilisks-in-the-market-brundt-again-aft.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
basilisks-in-the-market-brundt-again-aft.text: [Fremennik name]! Get to the boat. It's time for us to go!

island-of-stone-brundt.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
island-of-stone-brundt.text: This isn't good [Fremennik name]. The prison has already been breached.

island-of-stone-brundt.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
island-of-stone-brundt.text: Not quite, but we'll have to act fast. If the Jormungand manages to leave the prison, the End of Things will be upon us.

island-of-stone-brundt.player: Well we'd better get in there and make sure that doesn't happen.

island-of-stone-brundt.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
island-of-stone-brundt.text: It looks like the basilisks resealed the door behind them. We'll have to get through it.

island-of-stone-brundt.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
island-of-stone-brundt.text: From what I can tell, the door uses a combination lock. You'll need to get the right combination to unlock it. Too many wrong attempts will reset the lock though.

island-of-stone-brundt.player: I'd better be careful then. I'll get to work.

island-of-stone-brundt.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
island-of-stone-brundt.text: Hurry [Fremennik name]. We can't afford to waste any time.

island-of-stone-brundt-brundt-again.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
island-of-stone-brundt-brundt-again.text: Have you opened the door yet?

island-of-stone-brundt-brundt-again.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
island-of-stone-brundt-brundt-again.text: Hurry [Fremennik name]. We need to get inside before it's too late.

island-of-stone-brundt-unlocking-the-doo.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
island-of-stone-brundt-unlocking-the-doo.text: Good work [Fremennik name]. Let's get inside and see what's going on.

island-of-stone-brundt-again-after-unloc.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
island-of-stone-brundt-again-after-unloc.text: Let's get inside and see what's going on.

island-of-stone-brundt-again-after-unloc.speaker: Bakuna
island-of-stone-brundt-again-after-unloc.text: Destroy them! Our king must be freed!

island-of-stone-brundt-again-after-unloc.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
island-of-stone-brundt-again-after-unloc.text: With me [Fremennik name]! Let's kill these foul beasts!

island-of-stone-the-jormungand.speaker: The Jormungand
island-of-stone-the-jormungand.text: At long last, I have been granted freedom. You have done well Bakuna.

island-of-stone-the-jormungand.speaker: The Jormungand
island-of-stone-the-jormungand.text: Good, for I have one final use of you. My long rest has weakened me, you will grant me strength.
The Jormungand kills Bakuna in one hit

island-of-stone-the-jormungand.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
island-of-stone-the-jormungand.text: This isn't over yet [Fremennik name], the Jormungand is weak from his imprisonment! We can still stop him!

island-of-stone-the-jormungand.speaker: The Jormungand
island-of-stone-the-jormungand.text: Humans, you have been bestowed with a great honour, for you are about to become the first of your kind in millennia to feed my power!

island-of-stone-the-jormungand.speaker: The Jormungand
island-of-stone-the-jormungand.text: Rejoice with me, for your miserable lives are finally at an end!

island-of-stone-the-jormungand.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
island-of-stone-the-jormungand.text: You will not defeat us this day! Come [Fremennik name]!

island-of-stone-the-jormungand-in-combat.text: If The Jormungand uses his glare attack:

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Turn away [Fremennik name]!

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Don't look into his eyes!

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Don't look at him [Fremennik name]!

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: [Fremennik name]! Do not face him!

island-of-stone-the-jormungand-in-combat.text: If The Jormungand uses his binding attack:

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: The stone is weak! You can break it!

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: Try to break free [Fremennik name]!

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: [Fremennik name]! You need to break loose!

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: You can free yourself [Fremennik name]!

island-of-stone-brundt-again-after-leavi.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
island-of-stone-brundt-again-after-leavi.text: Hurry [Fremennik name]! We need to get inside and stop those basilisks!

island-of-stone-attempting-to-enter-the-.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
island-of-stone-attempting-to-enter-the-.text: Wait [Fremennik name]! I have some things for you!

steps.player: Do you have any of my items?

steps.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
steps.text: I do have some of your items here [Fremennik name]. Do try to be careful with them.

steps.target: Brundt the Cheiftain's Item Retrieval Service

island-of-stone-brundt-s-right-click-col.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
island-of-stone-brundt-s-right-click-col.text: I'm afraid I don't have anything for you [Fremennik name]. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.

island-of-stone-after-killing-the-jormun.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
island-of-stone-after-killing-the-jormun.text: Ah, nothing like a glorious fight to make you feel alive!

island-of-stone-after-killing-the-jormun.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
island-of-stone-after-killing-the-jormun.text: Now? We drink of course! The Jormungand has been defeated and the End of Things prevented!

island-of-stone-after-killing-the-jormun.player: Are you sure? They did manage to free him. How do you know we weren't too late?

island-of-stone-after-killing-the-jormun.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
island-of-stone-after-killing-the-jormun.text: You worry too much [Fremennik name]. If the end had begun, we'd have noticed by now. Come! Let us go and celebrate!

longhall-celebration.text: A cutscene starts with Olaf the Bard singing the Ballad of the Basilisk in the Rellekka longhall
After the first verse, the camera tilts down to reveal the adventurer standing amidst celebrating Fremenniks, leaving the bard to sing three more verses off-screen

longhall-celebration.speaker: Manni the Reveller
longhall-celebration.text: Another great victory for our people!

longhall-celebration.speaker: Brundt the Chieftain
longhall-celebration.text: But it wouldn't have been possible without [Fremennik name]!

longhall-celebration.speaker: Agnar
longhall-celebration.text: You have truly proven yourself to be one of us, [Fremennik name]! I'm sorry we ever doubted you.

longhall-celebration.player: I'm just glad it all worked out in the end.

longhall-celebration.speaker: Manni the Reveller
longhall-celebration.text: And on that note, time for a drink! I want to see if [Fremennik name] can still drink me under the table!
